description.value:
You create a violent, caustic underbrush that harms those who try to traverse it. When you cast a spell, acidic vines and roots sprout in the area within range, even reaching out to affect creatures above or around corners. This area is difficult terrain. A creature that starts their turn in or enters the vines needs to make a Reflex saving throw. If they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} by this spell, they take 4d6 acid damage immediately and at the start of their turns while they remain immobilized. A creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} from the vines using your spell DC. A creature who is reduced to 0 hit points by this spell has their vital energies drained from them, nourishing you, and you gain hit points equal to the creature’s level (minimum 0).

Critical Success The creature is not immobilized, but the vines remain as difficult terrain.

Success As critical success, but the creature takes the acid damage as if they were immobilized.

Failure The creature becomes immobilized for 1 round or until they escape.

Critical Failure The creature becomes immobilized until the spell ends or until they escape.  

Heightened (+1) The acid damage increases by 1d6 and you can increase the area of the spell by up to 5 additional feet.
